text: Being here, I am struck by the contrast between constraint and creative potential. The glass-walled conference room in the first scene evokes a sense of anticipation and order—a space awaiting conversation, perhaps debate. Entering the second scene, the R+D wall, screens, and interactive displays create an atmosphere of restless intellectual energy. I feel aware of the boundaries and rules that surround institutional spaces, yet I’m also inspired by the effort to experiment and push beyond them. Here, curiosity and inquiry feel both encouraged and contained.
